name: Tesamorelin
description: A stabilised analogue of growth hormone-releasing hormone approved to reduce excess visceral abdominal fat in HIV-associated lipodystrophy.

systems.note: Stimulates endogenous GH release at the somatotroph; placed on the pituitary by intended effect, not on the tissues GH later reaches.
Reduction of visceral adipose tissue is the labelled indication.
Raised GH exposure worsens glucose tolerance; labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled monitoring parameter for GH exposure.
Interval glycaemic tracking under raised GH.
